mistakes.text: She should have drew it further from the water.
mistakes.normalized: she should have drew it further from the water
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „should have“ patrí past participle: „drawn“, nie „drew“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „should have“ patří past participle: „drawn“, ne „drew“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “should have” use the past participle: “drawn”, not “drew”.

mistakes.text: She had to draw it further from the water.
mistakes.normalized: she had to draw it further from the water
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Had to“ znamená musela. „Mala to nakresliť“ (ale nenakreslila) je „should have drawn“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Had to“ znamená musela. „Měla to nakreslit“ (ale nenakreslila) je „should have drawn“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Had to” means it was necessary; for advice not followed use “should have drawn”.

mistakes.feedback_en: “Far” has an irregular comparative: “further” or “farther”, not “more far”.
